title: loopLifecycle
responsibility: Registers CLI commands for listing open loops and explicitly closing a loop as abandoned, including input validation and user-facing output.

inputs.name: registerLoopLifecycleCommands.command
inputs.description: Commander command to which the `list` and `close` subcommands are attached.

outputs.name: registerLoopLifecycleCommands
outputs.description: No return value; registers list and close subcommands on the supplied Commander command.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Invalid --stale values or missing abandonment confirmation are reported as expected CLI errors; downstream loop workflows may also reject.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
